pointsOfInterest.name: The Keeper Enclave Ruins
pointsOfInterest.description: The ancient ruins of a Keeper Enclave that existed thousands of years ago. A place of pilgrimage for Keeper Seekers and those drawn to the Veil.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Venox Cave
pointsOfInterest.description: A dangerous cave system inhabited by venox creatures. Contains valuable Veil-touched crystals but extremely dangerous.

pointsOfInterest.name: Abandoned Rebel Base
pointsOfInterest.description: An early Free Worlds base that was abandoned after its discovery by the Iron Dominion. May still contain valuable intelligence.

pointsOfInterest.name: Caldon Settlement
pointsOfInterest.description: A peaceful agrarian settlement where those seeking a simple life away from the galactic core make their home.
